dohSettings.description: Configures DNS over HTTPS (DoH). This setting's value is an object of type $(ref:DoHConfig). Setting it requires the "proxy" permission and private browsing access.

types.description: An object encapsulating a DNS Record.

canonicalName.description: The canonical hostname for this record.  this value is empty if the record was not fetched with the 'canonical_name' flag.

types.description: An object which describes DNS over HTTPS settings. Properties that are not specified are reset to their default value.

mode.description: The DNS resolution mode. default lets Firefox decide, off disables DoH, doh-first uses DoH and falls back to the native resolver if DoH fails, doh-only only uses DoH.

url.description: The https URL of the DoH server. An empty string means the Firefox default DoH server. Only allowed in doh-first and doh-only modes.

bootstrapAddress.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address of the DoH server, used instead of resolving the hostname of url with the native resolver. Only allowed in doh-first and doh-only modes.

excludedDomains.description: Domains, including their subdomains, that are always resolved with the native resolver.

functions.name: resolve
functions.description: Resolves a hostname to a DNS record.

parameters.name: record
parameters.description: The DNS record for the hostname.
